flame_t.note: battle map: one narrow tongue, ~1/2 tile tall; 3-5 per 32x16 cell in an ellipse, 8-12 on a 2x2 site

flame_t_small.note: battle map: a small tongue for gaps and for embers on ruins

flame.note: a narrow translucent tongue; stand 3-6 of them on a tile, spread in an ellipse twice as wide as it is deep, with different frame offsets

flame_small.note: a smaller tongue for the gaps between the big ones and for embers on ruins

smoke.note: one particle's life, frame 0 -> 7: grows and fades; emitter spawns one every ~250ms and moves it up ~22px/s with a slight drift
